sections.source_supported: Optional color, activating-stack versus internal-message fallback, END reset, and generated-message color propagation trace to CommandReturn and SequenceDiagram. sections.adversarial_boundary: Unknown colors must fail HColorSet.getColor; parallel returns use PARALLEL and goParallel. Rust ReturnMessage has no parallel field and try_return only recognizes a leading return token. Fresh negative/color and parallel controls challenge those boundaries.

Rust reverse branch handles normal/async/half heads but does not port those decoration-specific x adjustments there. A fresh active reverse-cross input targets the omission.

Creation, standalone destruction, and parallel probes test these discrepancies.

Fresh initial-depth/group-note/destruction controls bound the claim.
